errors.text_span: Визуално е забележимо, че за повечето държави синият компонент (Човешки капитал) е най-голям по височина, следван от червения (Свързаност)
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. A visual inspection of the bar chart shows that for the vast majority of countries, the red component ('Свързаност') is the largest, not the blue one ('Човешки капитал'). The blue component is the largest in only a few cases (e.g., AT, FR).

The description correctly identifies that the bar for Bulgaria (BG) is highlighted, but it fails to describe the data for this highlighted element. It should have mentioned its approximate total value (just under 40) and the relative size of its components (e.g., that 'Свързаност' - red is the largest component), which are key details for an emphasized element.
